items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: It was Thomas Jefferson, Adam Lambert, and Famous Lambert, and Stanley Williams. That was a good band.

ctx.x: Right. Anything else you remember about Louis at the Rhythm Club, or the Rhythm Club in general?

Well, I went there one time and heard the Six Brown Cats. You ever hear them? Yeah. It was Thomas Jefferson, Adam Lambert, and Famous Lambert, and Stanley Williams. That was a good band. They had a good band. They played at the Rhythm Club every Sunday in the afternoon.
Was it always a place where you, was it a sit down place or could you dance?
